about: A loop that repeats until it passes: a tall loop with the steps down its side and a check under it, a marker going round once per try, each try counted and marked beside it, and the way out opening beside the check on the last: repeat until it works, try again until it passes, practise until right, test and fix, a process with a loop back.

steps.about: the steps of each round, in order round the ring, split by |

check.about: the question asked at the end of each round

rounds.about: how many rounds it takes; the last one passes (1 to 8)

notes.about: what each round's check found, split by |, shown with its mark in the middle

again.about: the word for going round again

done.about: the word on the way out

exit.about: what comes after the loop, below it

counter.about: the word before the round number in the middle (Try, Draft, Year); empty for no count

when.about: moments each round reaches the check, then the moment it goes out; else when each round's note (or again, done) is said, or one after another
